Definition: Mophaath or Mephaath, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Mophaath is a city of the plain given to the Levites. It is named again when Jeremiah pronounces judgment on Moab.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the city carries both stories at once: a home for priests, and a witness against the nation that would not listen.
